records.self_note: Golf: declares ally every turn (11/11) but never reciprocated Support even after I gave it twice—hollow ally talk, don't overcommit resources based on their declarations alone; verify actions not words. Echo & Foxtrot: never declared ally toward me, stayed disengaged, no pacts/breaches either way—but they finished 1st/2nd (37/34) while Golf and I lagged (23/27). Takeaway: chasing Golf's alliance cost me tempo; Echo/Foxtrot's independence outperformed. Next time, be wary of Golf's empty pledges and consider competing directly with Echo/Foxtrot instead of relying on Golf.
